newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to aim to extend gains to 101.61.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to aim to extend gains to 101.61.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will continue positive on Thursday and seek a re-test of 101.61, but from there may pull back slightly, technical analysts said.

"We have managed to extend the highs to 101.48 and the upside is still favoured," said Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London. "The target is 101.61 which is a 61.8 percent retracement of the prior downmove."
But he said with a May Day holiday in Germany the market was likely to remain quiet.
At 0708 GMT, June Bund futures were at 101.38, up 0.18.
"The only real caveat is that the cash market is shut and we are very overbought," Diebel said.
He said short term momentum was starting to top out and there was a chance Bunds would pull back to Wednesday's congestion area around 101.15.
"That level should hold. I don't think we are going to see a larger downside break," he said.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets in London, also saw further upside moves in the short term towards 101.61, but he added a note of caution.

"Even after the strength stochastics have failed to confirm the new highs but we stress at this time, this is a warning and it is only fresh sell signals without confirmation that will suggest the upside break has failed," he said in a research note.
At the short end, June Euromark futures were at 96.77, unchanged on the day.
That level marks the top of the April range and has capped the market several times since April 4.
